title: Tangkhul Tuitam Kachiko
title_translation: Tangkhul Literature Reader for Class IX
creator: Tangkhul Literature Society Editorial Board
author: Tangkhul Literature Society
notes: Approved Board of Secondary Education Manipur (BSEM) literature curriculum reader compiling selected 20th-century poems, essays, and short stories for Class IX.
indigenous_tangkhul_text: Tangkhul Tuitam Kachiko Class IX literature textbook thada BSEM Manipur-wui official curriculum-li serve sakya.
20th-century poems (Ava Ram Leishat), short stories (Maranwon), cultural essays, kala grammar rules curate sakya.
Secondary school students-li standard literary orthography, critical analysis, kala creative writing inspire sakya.
english_translation_text: Tangkhul Tuitam Kachiko serves as the official Class IX literature textbook approved by the Board of Secondary Education Manipur.
Curating seminal 20th-century poems, short stories, historical essays, and advanced grammatical paradigms.
It has educated generations of high school students in refined literary orthography and critical literary appreciation.
literary_themes: Curricular codification of modern Tangkhul literature
Patriotic poetry, social realism, and moral philosophy
structure_and_meter: Pedagogical anthology organized into thematic units (Poetry, Short Stories, Historical Prose, Grammar Exercises).
critical_commentary: First published in 2000 by TLS, this volume marked a major milestone in formalizing Tangkhul as an approved matriculation language subject.

poetic_vocabulary_terms.Tuitam-Kakaso: Instruction in syntax and literary appreciation
